title: No appeal unless 50% of amount deposited

content.scenario: A consumer files an appeal with the State Commission, but the consumer is required to pay an amount in terms of an order of the District Commission.
content.outcome: No appeal by a person, who is required to pay any amount in terms of an order of the District Commission, shall be entertained by the State Commission unless the appellant has deposited fifty per cent. of that amount in the manner as may be prescribed.

user_queries: What happens if a consumer files an appeal with the State Commission?
Can an appeal be filed if the consumer is required to pay an amount in terms of an order of the District Commission?
How does the deposit of 50% of the amount affect the appeal process?
